guarantees.claim: ctr_o_rev is always equal to ctr_i_rev except for the bit slice indexed by ctr_slice_idx, which is driven by ctr_o_slice.

assumptions.claim: ctr_slice_idx must be within the valid bit range of ctr_o_rev (0 to width-1).
assumptions.risk: Out-of-range index causes simulation X-propagation or synthesis undefined behavior, possibly corrupting counter value.

uncertain_points.claim: The intent of updating only one bit slice of ctr_o_rev using ctr_o_slice is ambiguous without the broader CTR increment specification.
uncertain_points.risk: If the update does not match the required counter progression, the AES CTR stream may produce incorrect keystream, compromising encryption integrity.
